title: Custom Soccer Player Goal Comforter Set, Machine Washable - Design 8
description:
Inspire dreams of the field with this Jeminise Comforter Set, perfect for young soccer enthusiasts. This personalized bedding allows you to add a name and number, making it a unique addition to any soccer fan's room.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Designed to inspire young soccer fans and fuel their passion for the sport.
  • Personalized Design: Customize with a name and number for a unique touch.
  • Easy to Use: Features a hidden zipper and smooth metal pull for effortless duvet insertion or removal.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Environmentally friendly finishing process ensures dye retention and prevents fading.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin, US Full, US Queen, and US King to fit various bed sizes.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water and air dries quickly for convenient maintenance.
  • Material Details: Crafted from durable polycotton fabric.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polycotton
Fabric Type Polycotton
Pattern Soccer
Selected Design A4
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 1 text input
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Selected Size Full
Style Name Modern
Pillowcase Quantity 2
Pillowcase Length 20 inches
Pillowcase Width 20 inches
Thread Count 360
Care Instructions Machine Wash
